submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Fe0.78Sb0.22) had the highest measured EQE, 0.237%. Index 0 (Fe0.84) gave 0.212% and index 12 (Fe0.49, FeSbO4-type) was about -0.008%. So photoactivity is concentrated on the Fe-rich (hematite-like) side, and a modest amount of Sb (about 20%) looks optimal or close to it.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.212%, below index 3; adding more Fe beyond 78% did not help.
Measured -0.008%; the FeSbO4 composition is essentially inactive at 2.4 eV.
